description: This PHP class defines an Immigration display field within the OrangeHRM reporting system. It extends a listable display field and specifies details such as the associated Data Transfer Object (DTO) class, entity alias, and specific fields related to employee immigration records.

classes.name: Immigration
classes.description: Represents an Immigration display field for reporting purposes, extending a listable display field class.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in queries for this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields that this display field will include.
